fichas.title: Contact and Area Surveillance: Appropriate Use of Burglar Alarms
fichas.summary: A matrix indicates which burglar-alarm types are very suitable or still suitable for protecting building components and equipment. It covers doors, windows, walls, floors, objects, safes, cupboards, conduits, and service installations, with footnotes specifying use restrictions and protection conditions.
uses: Select burglar-alarm types for protecting building components and equipment
Guide protection of doors, windows, glazing, walls, floors, objects, safes, cupboards, and service installations
figure_refs: Contact and area surveillance — appropriate use of burglar alarms

fichas.title: Room Surveillance: Comparative Features of Detectors
fichas.summary: A comparison table describes ultrasound room protection, ultrasound Doppler, high-frequency Doppler, and infrared detectors. It compares coverage and surveillance range, applications, ambient-temperature suitability, sensor multiplicity, effects from neighboring spaces or road traffic, and possible causes of false alarms.
uses: Compare detector technologies for room surveillance
Assess coverage, application, operating conditions, and potential false alarms

fichas.title: Electronic Security Systems
fichas.summary: The page describes goods-security systems for preventing unauthorized removal of goods; access-control systems that check identity or authorization and may be combined with time recording; remote-control systems for exchanging data between locations; surveillance systems using cameras and monitors; and lift emergency systems for communication and rescue of trapped passengers.
uses: Prevent theft and unauthorized removal of goods
Grant or refuse access based on identity or authorization
Transmit data for remote monitoring, control, diagnosis, and information queries
Observe, control, and record events inside and outside buildings
Enable communication and rescue of people trapped in lifts

dimensions.label: Surveillance operation duration
dimensions.context: Surveillance systems may operate at any time of day or night throughout the year.
